criteria.text:
Running `pdd lint --local` on a screen prompt with `

Waiting for approval

` against a `.ui.svg` drawing that contains `wait-card`, `status-chip` and `Refresh` (`id="refresh"`) warns for `"Sign out"`, `"sign-out"` and `"sign-out-action"`, emits 0 missing-control warnings for `"app-shell"`, `"app"`, `"body pushed no-dock"`, `"chip st-waiting"`, `"status"` or `"true"`, and exits with code 0.

Running `pdd lint --local` on a screen prompt with single-quoted `
` and negated prose `No button shows "Loading..." while idle.` against a `.ui.svg` drawing that contains `Retry` (`id="retry"`) emits 0 warnings and exits with code 0.

Running `pdd lint --local` on a screen prompt with ``Use buttons with label "Start". `instructions` says "Arrow keys to steer. Enter to start. P to pause. R to restart." Also explain "Automatic moves wait at least 1 second plus interpreter time." No button directly advances a move: the host timer does that automatically while the live Screen is visible.`` against a `.ui.svg` drawing showing `Start` and both help texts emits 0 warnings, including 0 warnings for `" Also explain "`, and exits with code 0.

Running `pdd lint --local` on a 2048-like screen prompt with four direction buttons in prose and `SCORE`, `SEED` (`#score`, `#seed`) and `READY` (`#status`) in the `.ui.svg` drawing still warns for `"move-down"`, `"move-left"`, `"move-right"`, `"move-up"`, `label "READY"`, `region #score`, `region #seed` and `region #status`, and exits with code 0.

setup.isolation: Fresh temporary Git repository per case with external PDD_STATE_DIR and invalid PDD_RUNTIME_URL so authentication, network and model calls fail if attempted.
setup.production_flow: Write the case prompt and .ui.svg files into the temporary Git repository, call lintSvgLayouts({root, files}) directly, and also run runPdd(["lint", "--local", "--json"], ports) after staging the files in Git with a valid native-only Runtime interface on the temporary screen prompt.
